_comment_scan_code: Set scan_code to true to enable Azure DevOps git repo scanning for application-level dependency detection. Requires azure_devops credentials below.
_comment_azure_devops: Configure your Azure DevOps organisation and PAT token. 'projects' is a list of project names to scan; leave empty [] to scan all projects. 'repositories' inside each project entry is optional — omit to scan all repos in that project. Use 'branch' to override the default branch per-repo.
_comment_git_tuning: Git clone / scan tuning knobs. git_clone_depth: shallow clone depth (1 = fastest). git_clone_workers: parallel repo clone threads. git_max_file_kb: skip files larger than this size. git_scan_extensions: only scan files with these extensions. git_skip_dirs: directory names to skip during scanning.
